components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen, such as Sign in.
components.css: .ds-btn{width:220px;padding:14px;background:#2d7a4d;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:30px;font:600 16px 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .3s ease,transform .3s ease}.ds-btn:hover{background:#4caf50}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2d7a4d;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled field with a soft green focus glow.
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;margin-bottom:6px;font:600 12.5px 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;color:#45514a}.ds-input{width:240px;padding:13px 15px;border:1px solid #e6e6e6;border-radius:10px;background:#fafafa;font:14px 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;transition:border-color .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease}.ds-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:#4caf50;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(76,175,80,.12)}

narrative.overview: VET Vision reads like a well-kept record book for the clinic: white pages on a pale green-grey desk, thin hairlines, and one calm green voice. Flat with hairlines; soft and reassuring controls.
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces on a pale green-grey page.
One green family for action, focus and positive state; red and amber only for danger and warning.
Corners 8-14px, pill for the main call to action.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Green is the only brand color. Red and amber carry meaning, never decoration.

rules.name: The Tint Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a hairline or a mist tint before reaching for a shadow.

rules.name: The Small Data Rule
rules.body: Data screens run at 13-14px. Type above 16px is only for page titles and KPI numbers.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces carry no shadow at rest; shadows answer hover, focus or elevation.

dos: **Do** use Clinic Green (#2d7a4d) for the one primary action on a screen.
**Do** separate surfaces with a Hairline (#ececec) or Page Mist before adding a shadow.
**Do** keep data text at 13-14px and reserve 28px for page titles.
**Do** show a visible focus ring on every interactive element (WCAG 2.1 AA).
**Do** tie every input to a visible label and give icon-only buttons an `aria-label`.
**Do** say when data is thin or stale, in Caution Amber on Amber Wash.
donts: **Don't** use Faint Ink (#9aa5a0) for text that must be read; it is too light.
**Don't** add a second brand hue, gradients or decorative color.
**Don't** animate `transform` in a keyframe on an element that positions itself with `transform`; the keyframe overrides the centering and the element jumps (the password eye button bug).
**Don't** use `transition: all`; list the properties that change.
**Don't** show a control the signed-in role cannot use.
